feed.title: feed
feed.blurb: Feed a hungry creature the words it asks for before its patience runs out, or run a buffet for a crowd.

castle.title: castle
castle.blurb: Build your walls out of words and hold the line until the attackers give up.

space.blurb: Steer with the mouse, fire with words, and keep the ship alive.

spot.blurb: Find the mistakes planted in a passage and put them right.
